profile_text.body:
Micron Technology Inc. describes itself as a global leader in memory and storage, providing semiconductor solutions for AI and compute-intensive applications from cloud to edge. Its website highlights mobile memory and storage for AI-driven technologies, along with design tools, data sheets, and a Technology Enablement Program.

SEC records identify Micron as a public, for-profit company with ticker MU and CIK 0000723125, headquartered in Boise, Idaho. The available record lists 21 legal exposure entries in Idaho and no litigation cases.
